newsitem.title: LATVIA: ZEMES BANK STARTS THREE, FIVE YEAR DEPOSITS.
newsitem.headline: ZEMES BANK STARTS THREE, FIVE YEAR DEPOSITS.

text.p: Zemes Bank, the eighth largest in Latvia by way of assets, said on Friday it will accept three and five year deposits as of April 14.
"The accepting of long-term deposits will create the possibility of giving long-term credits to individuals," the bank said in a statement.

A 36-month lat deposit with interest payment at the end of the period gives 7.75 percent interest and 8.0 percent on a 60-month deposit. A similar dollar deposit yields 6.8 percent and 7 percent respectively.
Up to now the longest term deposit, available with Zemes, was of 24 months with 7.5 percent on lat and 6.75 percent on the dollar.
